fichas.title: Marina Types and Facilities
fichas.summary: Classifies day, city/mini, event, regatta and Olympic, berth, tourist, association and club, dry, technical, and winter marinas by location, purpose, services, and facilities. Regatta and Olympic marinas require extensive competition, support, and spectator facilities; dry marinas prioritize land storage and boat launching; winter marinas provide boat storage with attention to fire hazards.
uses: Boat storage, launching, repair, and winter service
furniture_equipment: Medical care and doping testing facilities

fichas.title: Roads and Car Parks: Functions and Construction Quality
fichas.summary: Lists functional and construction requirements for trailer and towing-vehicle transport areas, boat land areas, emergency-service access roads, vehicle parking, and footpaths and cycleways. Requirements include adequate width, turning space, load-bearing capacity, drainage, separation from vehicles, clear marking, and appropriate frost-safe or waterbound surfacing.
spaces: Transport areas for trailers and towing vehicles
uses: Transporting and maneuvering trailers and towing vehicles
